svg.title: Screenly/cli PR #333: version bump to 26.11.0
svg.desc: Cargo.toml, the crate's Cargo.lock entry, the Dockerfile default release and the GitHub Action default cli_version move from 26.9.0 to 26.11.0; the binary reports the Cargo.toml version and the tag-driven release workflow publishes the assets the Dockerfile and the Action download.
svg.text: Moves the CLI from 26.9.0 to 26.11.0 in the four places the version lives. The tag v26.11.0, pushed after merge, drives the
release build, the MCP bundle and the Docker image.

g.text: Red = before the PR · green = after
WHAT REPORTS OR FETCHES THE VERSION
No schema change. No code change.
Tag v26.11.0 on master (pushed after merge)
MCP bundle version: set from the tag by release.yml
Release Docker job overrides RELEASE with the tag
Diff from the PR's files API; built with cargo --locked in rust:latest, base and head.
